issues.concern: The top-level gloss 'Miss' is ambiguous and could be misinterpreted as the verb 'to miss'.
issues.suggestion: Change 'Miss' to 'Miss (title)' or 'Ms.' to clarify its meaning as a title.

issues.concern: The semantic tag 'action' only applies to the 'mistake' sense when used as a verb-suru, but not to the 'Miss (title)' sense, nor to the noun 'mistake' itself.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'action' as a general semantic tag for the headword. If desired, apply it specifically to the verb-suru form or the 'mistake' sense.
